instruction: Fix `rotate` so it normalises k with a modulo, so k greater than the sequence length rotates correctly.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops.py b/seqops.py
--- a/seqops.py
+++ b/seqops.py
@@ -36,6 +36,7 @@
 
 def rotate(seq, k):
     """Rotate ``seq`` to the left by ``k`` positions."""
+    k = k % len(seq)
     return seq[k:] + seq[:k]
